data.long_meaning: Arja is derived from the Sanskrit word 'arati' which means 'to be adored'. It is also a name of the Pandava hero Arjuna from the Mahabharata epic. The name Arja carries the meaning “Adorable, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arja usually hope their child will grow to embody adorable, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
